API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIUser ManagementGet Departments
Get Departments
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/departments

Retrieves a list of departments. The search parameters find matching values within the name or comments fields.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to match against a department's name or comments attributes

page
int32

Specifies the page offset

Default value: 1
limitSearch
boolean

Limits the search to match only against the department name

Default value: false
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size

Default value: 100
sortBy
string

Possible values: [id, name, expiry, status, externalId, rank]

Sorts the departments based on available values

Default value: id
sortOrder
string

Possible values: [asc, desc, ruleExecution]

Sorts the order of departments based on available values

Default value: asc
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

Department ID

name
string
REQUIRED

Department name

idpId
int64

Identity provider (IdP) ID. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

comments
string

Additional information about this department. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

deleted
boolean

List of deleted departments

Default value: false
]
